name.description: `name`: The type of contact method. It is an enum with values like 'Web site' or 'E-mail'.

location.description: `location`: The location associated with the contact method, either a URL or an email address.

title:
`ContactUrl` type is used to represent a contact method with a specific name (such as 'Web site' or 'E-mail')
and a location (the actual URL or email address).
name: ContactUrl
